critical_code_review_comments: Implementation is correct and complete. The inventoryEnforced flag is properly derived from restaurant.inventory_negative and threaded through all 3 layers of inventory enforcement.
Default value of inventoryEnforced=true in component props ensures backward compatibility for any edge cases where the prop might not be passed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-2026-10-14-001 fix verified. Restaurant 689 (inventory_negative='Yes') now shows all 126 items without inventory restrictions. Restaurant 716 (inventory_negative='No') continues to enforce inventory as expected. The fix is FE-only, touching 6 files. Key logic: inventoryEnforced = restaurant?.inventory_negative === 'No' - only explicit 'No' enforces inventory.
rca_of_the_issue: The app was reading only stock_out/food_stock fields and never checking inventory_negative. When inventory_negative='Yes' (negative-stock mode enabled), the restaurant allows ordering items regardless of stock status. The fix adds a derived flag inventoryEnforced that gates all 3 layers of inventory enforcement: Layer-1 (menu filtering), Layer-2 (addToCart guard), Layer-3 (pre-submit check).
